sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT KIND OF PETS THE OTHER CALLER HAS.
turns: How's it going with your furry friends?
Pretty good, just got back from feeding the cats.
Cats are a pain sometimes, my friend over in Ohio had a cat that ate his power strip and wouldn't stop.
That's terrible, can you imagine? Mine just knocked over a glass of water last week but didn't eat anything.
Yeah, one of them chewed a cord and sparked the whole outlet.
Oh wow, that is scary. Did the outlet actually catch fire?
No, the smoke alarm went off first and he had to call 911.
Yeah, lucky that one didn't start a real blaze.
Yeah, scary stuff, but at least he's okay now.
He got lucky, though... my neighbor had a dog that ate his meds and ended up in the ER for a week.
That's rough, my cousin had a dog eat his heart meds too and he spent a week in the ICU.
Yeah, my dog is basically a hero for not eating that.
My cousin still has nightmares about it sometimes, even though the vet said he'd be fine.
Yeah, that's actually the hardest part, knowing they won't be okay even when they are.
Yeah, it's just hard when they're your best friend, even if they're technically fine.
Yeah, I guess that's why I don't really get into it, my cousin wouldn't let me near him after that.
Yeah, same here, I'd rather just stick to my fish.
Yeah, I'll just stick to my goldfish too.
Not that I'm complaining, goldfish are pretty chill, no drama there at all.
Yeah, definitely less drama with the goldfish.
I'm actually kind of relieved about that, to be honest.
Yeah, I guess goldfish are pretty low maintenance too.
Yeah, definitely less drama with the goldfish.
Yeah, that's probably why I'm glad I just keep it simple.
Exactly, that's the only pet I'd feel comfortable owning if I had to go down that route.
Yeah, that makes sense, keep it simple is usually the safest bet.
Yeah, honestly, keeping it simple just feels less risky than taking a chance on something that might bite back.
Yeah, plus fish are easy to explain to my bank manager if he asks.
Yeah, fish are just easier to hide from the family too.
Yeah, I'm glad you feel that way, honestly.
Yeah, I wouldn't want to deal with someone else's drama if I'm the only one around anyway.
Yeah, probably wouldn't want the stress of a whole other animal if I'm the only one around anyway.
Yeah, you know, I think I'll stick to the fish, just to be safe.
Yeah, that's probably the smartest move.
You know, I guess I'll just keep my tank small to start.
